definitions.short: Tsidon , the name of a son of Canaan, and of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H6721. Tsidon צִידוֺן and ( Gen 10:15 , 19 ; 49:3 ) צִידֹן proper name, of a location Sidon , Σιδων , ancient Phoenician city, on coast north of Tyre (in Assyrian ‚idum( n)u, COT Gloss ; Tel Amarna ‚iduna , Phoenician צדן , Old Aramaic צידן ; in Egyptian D±-(d)u-na , WMM As.u.Eur.184 ); — 'first-born' of Canaan 10:15 = 1Chr 1:13 ; northern limit of Canaanite Gen 10:19 , compare 49:13 defined as ׳צ רַבָּה Josh 11:8 (so 19:28 below); also Judg 1:31 ; 10:6 ( צ ׳אֱהֵֹי ), 18:28 ; 1Kin 17:9 ; named with Tyre Josh 19:28 (compare 19:29 ), 2Sam 24:6 (compare 24:7 ), Isa 23:2 , 4 and בַּתצֿ ׳בְּתוּלַת 23:12 (compare 23:5 etc.), Jer 25:22 ; 27:3 ; 47:4 ; Ezek 27:8 ; 28:21-22 , (compare 28:2 ; 28:12 ), Zech 9:2 ; Joel 4:4. — See Pietschm Phöniz. 54 ff. Prutz Aus Phönicien (1876), 98 ff. Rob BR ii.478 ff. de Luynes Voyage à la mer Morte i 18 ff., and Plural vi-xi. Bd Pal 3 (1898), 313 ff.
definitions.rootNote: or צִידֹן ; from 6679 in the sense of catching fish; fishery;
